turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Monday going in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! It's been a busy day, but I actually managed to squeeze in a run after school.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great! A run is a perfect way to decompress after teaching. How was the weather for it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was actually really nice, a bit cool but dry. Definitely cleared my head after dealing with high schoolers all day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine! Have you had any time for your woodworking lately, or has teaching been keeping you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mostly too busy. I have some ideas for a new shelf, but I haven't had a chance to get out to the garage and work on it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hopefully you'll get some shop time soon. How is Grace doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's doing well! She had a pretty long day at work too, so we're both ready to just collapse on the couch.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A quiet evening sounds perfect. Do you two have a relaxed night planned?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, we're just going to make some dinner and then watch a cooking competition show.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, those are always fun! Is it a baking one or more of a savory challenge?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's one where they have to make gourmet meals out of mystery ingredients. It's highly entertaining and doesn't require too much brainpower.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to wind down. Enjoy the show and have a wonderful evening with Grace!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I will. Talk to you later.
